structured_output.what_is_happening: GRAM "gram token" is a Solana coin about 16 minutes old. It launched straight onto a PumpSwap pool rather than a pump.fun curve (deploy platform unknown) and has about $32k market cap and $38k liquidity. In the first hour it traded about $467k volume, price is up about 129%, and it drew 799 unique buyers against 122 sellers. The coin's only listed link, the GeckoTerminal "twitter handle" field, points to a Telegram X status (telegram/status/2103568454754427216). That suggests the coin is riffing on an official Telegram/TON post about Gram. TON renamed Toncoin to Gram in June 2026, and Telegram began rolling out the Gram Wallet on Aug 31. Several copycat "gram token" coins launched within the same ~2 minutes.
